name: Suisui

tierList.prydwen: Support: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Rectifier Support specializing in buffing Negative Status consumers (Hiyuki, Yangyang: Xuanling), a Mornye-type healer/buffer. Alternates Zephyr Stance (opener) and Drizzle Stance (main buffing phase, entered instantly via Intro).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance (4 hits) / Drizzle Stance (4 hits, pulls + Glacio Chafe on Stage 4).
skills.resonanceSkill: Vernal Screen - Zephyr Stance thrust; Awakening Spring at full Cloud Breath enters Drizzle Stance (pull + Glacio Chafe + team Enrichment stack).
skills.forte: Lambent Gold - governs Cloud Breath (Zephyr, max 120) and Floral Epistle (Drizzle, max 600) resources feeding Outro's tiered buff unlocks.
skills.liberation: Song of Thoroughfare - deploys Ceaseless Landscape (30s): raises max Negative Status stack caps by 3 and grants Havoc Bane DEF/RES Shred synergy.
skills.intro: Tinkling Jade - Glacio hit + Glacio Chafe, consumes Cloud Breath to pull + enter Drizzle Stance.
skills.outro: Rippling Waters - 25% All DMG Amplification to team for 30s; tiered bonus effects (Reflecting Shadows, Roaming Transcendent Plume Steps, Undulating Mist ATK buff) based on Floral Epistle consumed (0/200/400/600).

bestWeapons: Stellar Symphony (Shorekeeper sig, good Energy Regen)
echoSet: Song of Feathered Trace (best - 25% team ATK via Glacio Chafe + Energy Regen scaling)

teams.name: Hiyuki Team
teams.notes: Applies Glacio Chafe for Hiyuki, a key replacement for Chisa.

teams.name: Yangyang: Xuanling Team
teams.notes: Havoc Bane synergy completes her best team.

teams.name: Aemeath Team (Fusion Burst)
teams.notes: Viable alternative when the Negative Status-consuming Hypercarry buff isn't strictly needed.

rotation: Opener: Basic: Zephyr 1,2,3 -> Skill: Awakening Spring -> Swallow's Cut -> Drizzle Basic 1-4 (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Outro. Loop: Intro -> Skill: Drizzle (dash-cancel) -> Drizzle Basic 1-4 (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Outro. At S3+, skip straight from Skill to Basic Drizzle 4.
communityNotes: Prydwen: the best Support for Negative Status Hypercarries and a currently top-tier meta pick, easy rotation and F2P-friendly (Variation is a fine signature replacement), but her strongest buffs require literal Negative Status consumption which limits flexibility, and she has almost no quickswap headroom or Sequence scaling.
